correctness.rationale: Theorem A of Kazaniecki–Lechner supplies almost projectional factorization S≈ADB with ||A||||B||→1. On the nonempty infinite-dimensional canonical range E_t, the coefficient λ is constant on the block, and λ^(-1)Q_t S|E_t=Id. Neumann inversion of λ^(-1)Q_t ADB|E_t yields an exact Id_E=A′DB′ with limsup||A′||||B′||≤||Q_t||/|λ|. For any strictly singular R, A′RB′ is strictly singular and cannot lie inside the unit norm ball centered at Id_E; taking infima yields dist(D,SS)≥|λ|/||Q_t||. Identity coefficients give 1−λ for Id−D. Compact⊂SS yields the stated essential-norm estimates. Critically all estimates are valid but are direct standard consequences of the cited factorization.
